summary: Three more model leans published at 11:22 ET under the widened rule (a calibrated point or more over the price on a total, nothing sourced against): Panthers at Falcons over 43.5 at ESPN BET -105; Eagles at Titans over 39.5 at BetMGM -108; Seahawks at Cardinals over 41 at BetMGM -108. Commanders at Cowboys under 51 sits at 0.8 points and stays on the board only. Nothing settled, nothing closed.

gamePicks.quoteNote: ESPN BET's price from the 8:37 AM ET capture across five books, the best number and price on the board for this side.

gamePicks.cutoff: OVER 43.5 at -105 or better. Closed to new entries at 45+, or at -120 or worse at 43.5.
gamePicks.why: Model lean, published on our number alone. Our total is 45.8 against 43.5 and the over reads 52.9% after calibration, 1.7 points over what -105 needs. The line has moved from 42.5 to 43.5 since Saturday, toward our number, and ESPN BET holds the best price at the same number. Falcons went from -1.5 to +2.5 at home this week. Nothing sourced argues against it; nothing sourced argues for it beyond the model. Published so the model's totals build a live record.
gamePicks.risk: One game of history for both teams; a thin model number is the model's most common error, and the market knows things the model does not. Also a leg of today's longshot, so a miss here costs twice.
